title: Vuber Sol Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The SOL is a dry herb vaporizer with a sleek, compact design and feature-packed performance. Its ceramic heating chamber and adjustable temperature settings let you optimize vapour quality, while its magnetic mouthpiece and 1100 mAh lithium-ion battery provide long-term durability. USB-C recharging ensures fast, convenient charging. The SOL also includes haptic feedback, which vibrates to let you know when you’ve reached the selected temperature.

Product Features:
– Five selectable temperatures (356°F, 374°F, 392°F, 410°F, 425°F)
– Auto-shut off
– Magnetic mouthpiece
– Haptic feedback
– 1100 mAh lithium-ion battery
– USB-C charging

What’s Included:
1 x SOL Battery
1 x SOL Mouthpiece
1 x USB-C Charging Cable
1 x Brush Tool
1 x Packing Tool
3 x Alcohol Cleaning Swabs
1 x SOL User Manual
